author: Scratched inside a sea chest lid
pages:
Do not anchor over the deep water by the arch of black rock. The bones on the sand there are not whales'.

We lost Tomas and the jolly boat. The thing came up under us like a hill rising. Scales the size of shields.
If you have found this chest, you have found its hoard too. Take it and row. Do not look back to see if it follows. It follows.
